strategyDefinition.entry: static percentage ladder below a completed-close anchor
strategyDefinition.exit: min(fixed take-profit, previous higher layer price)
strategyDefinition.reanchor: only after inventory is flat or risk cooldown ends
strategyDefinition.intrabar: adverse stop-first; new entries cannot take profit on the same candle
strategyDefinition.marking: terminal inventory is marked to market and charged estimated taker/slippage liquidation cost

feasibility.rule: Paper candidate requires positive validation/test median, >=60% positive instruments, positive stressed median, and <=10% worst test drawdown.
